scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to rational parameter values in Choudhry's displayed one-parameter order-\(6\) family and their nonzero affine normalizations. It does not exclude general order-\(6\) bimagic squares, other parametrized constructions, or algebraic parameter values. The defect factorization is reconstructed exactly from the published coefficient vectors and replayed by the supplied checker; the no-rational-root step is an independent \(3\)-adic argument.
title: Exact diagonal-square defect of Choudhry's one-parameter \(6\times 6\) pseudo-bimagic family
